statements.t: A replay of the webcast will be available at the Company’s investor relations website, investors.expeditions.com.

risks.t: the following: (i) adverse general economic and/or geopolitical factors that negatively impact the ability or desire of people to travel
(ii) loss of business due to competition
(iv) increases in fuel prices, changes in fuel consumed and availability of fuel supply in the geographies in which we operate or in general
(v) the loss of key employees, our inability to recruit or retain qualified shoreside and shipboard employees and increased labor costs
(vii) management of our growth and our ability to execute our planned growth, including our ability to successfully integrate any future acquisitions
(viii) our ability to maintain our relationships with National Geographic and/or World Wildlife Fund
(ix) our ability to maintain licenses and permits necessary for certain operations in compliance with laws, regulations and other requirements
(x) compliance with new and existing laws and regulations, including environmental regulations and travel advisories and restrictions
(xi) our substantial indebtedness and our ability to remain in compliance with the financial and/or operating covenants in such arrangements
(xii) the impact of material litigation, enforcement actions, claims, fines or penalties on our business
(xiii) the impact of severe or unusual weather conditions, including climate change, on our business
(xv) the result of future financing efforts
(xvi) those risks described in the Company’s filings with the SEC

statements.t: For a detailed discussion of our Critical Accounting Policies, please see our 2025 Annual Report, where we have discussed those policies and estimates that we believe are critical and require the use of complex judgment in their application.
